# Metadata edits use unique groups and noncanonical check names, even if setup fails.
# A title/body edit must never cancel or replace checks for the same code.

jobs.header:
packaged-smoke:
    needs: packaged-scope
    if: needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run == 'true' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    name: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && 'metadata packaged smoke' || 'packaged smoke' }} (${{ matrix.platform }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: darwin-arm64
            arch: arm64
            os: darwin
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_MACOS_ARM_RUNNER || 'namespace-profile-macos-15' }}
            pack: pack:mac:arm64
            bundle: release/mac-arm64/Agent Teams AI.app
          - platform: darwin-x64
            arch: x64
            os: darwin
            runner: macos-15-intel
            pack: pack:mac:x64
            bundle: release/mac/Agent Teams AI.app
          - platform: win32-x64
            arch: x64
            os: win32
            runner: windows-2022
            pack: pack:win:x64
            bundle: release/win-unpacked
          - platform: win32-arm64
            arch: arm64
            os: win32
            runner: windows-11-arm
            pack: pack:win:arm64
            bundle: release/win-arm64-unpacked
          - platform: linux-x64
            arch: x64
            os: linux
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
            pack: pack:linux
            bundle: release/linux-unpacked

    env:
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}

checkouts.text:

        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

# Draft PRs run finite peers and the separately declared OpenCode-only local-model lane.
# Existing native Claude/Codex gates keep their scope.

jobs.header:
offline-desktop-scenario:
    name: Offline Host Desktop (${{ matrix.platform || 'linux-x64' }}, ${{ matrix.lane }})
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        lane: [team, taskboard, skills, cross-team, collaboration, extensions, import, management, codex-login, codex, claude, claude-lifecycle, opencode, review, selection, processes]
        include:
          - lane: installer
            runner: macos-15
            platform: darwin-arm64
          - lane: opencode-v2-management
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux-x64
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_EMULATED_LANE: ${{ matrix.lane }}
      HOST_EMULATED_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform || 'linux-x64' }}

checkouts.text:
- uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

jobs.header:
offline-frontend-tests:
    name: Offline frontend tests (${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_TEST_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}

checkouts.text:

        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

jobs.header:

    needs: [offline-desktop-scenario, offline-frontend-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

actionProposal.title: Draft: frozen frontend parity read-boundary qualification (3e41e39b)
actionProposal.body:
## Purpose

Run the original qualification workflows against one frozen source cut containing the reviewed frontend/read-boundary changes, saved-Launch readiness repair, and Linux wrapper cleanup repair.

Saved Launch requires three eligible, matching target samples within its existing 30-second wait and keeps the final strict click guard. Linux cleanup recognizes only the exact captured MainThread zombie tuple and retains the original child, birth, group, invocation, signal and final-absence requirements. The selected renderer/read-boundary changes, prior privacy repair and bounded passive Teams/Windows diagnostics are preserved. Archived evidence paths were shortened without changing their raw contents or any Git setting.

## Frozen source and evidence

- Head: `3e41e39b101ccc06bb24203be245ac55dcf1502f` on `ci/frontend-parity-read-boundaries-c714-20261116`.
- Base: `b3e3bc604e2053b70de75d3d5307f408a04920a4` on `ci/frontend-parity-observer-base-c714-20261116`.
- [Resulting-source execution record](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/blob/3e41e39b101ccc06bb24203be245ac55dcf1502f/docs/plans/provider-migration/frontend-parity-2026-11-12/evidence/coobservation-2026-11-15/ui-regression-execution.json)
- [Lossless RED, GREEN and scoped-check evidence](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/blob/3e41e39b101ccc06bb24203be245ac55dcf1502f/docs/plans/provider-migration/frontend-parity-2026-11-12/evidence/coobservation-2026-11-15/ui-regression-local.zip)
- [Published bounded regression R1](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/blob/1929d64351d2356ceb05e907401cfae06b19fcb5/docs/plans/provider-migration/frontend-parity-2026-11-12/evidence/coobservation-2026-11-15/ui-failure-r1.md)

The two original whole files completed 136/136 tests with no failures, skips or cancellations after the one retained 107-pass/29-failure RED. The original scoped four-file lint, source-size guard and diff check completed successfully; the existing lint warning is retained. These local results bind producer source `574e0bddd237f605bf5581721a0a3b9f1cecbfa7`; this frozen head adds evidence only. The execution record discloses the true local Git HEAD, exact source overlays, unchanged compiled/provider inputs, original runner and consumed one-attempt limits. It grants no additional local build or compiler retry.

## Original resulting-source gates

All 42 root workflow definitions are unchanged. The exact base-to-head path inventory selects nine opened workflows: Announcements, General CI, CodeQL, Packaged, Host Emulated, Host Process, OpenCode Stage1, Sentry native and Teams creation.

Keep the original 18 Host Desktop lanes plus four frontend shards, five Process tuples, nine Stage1 jobs, five full-scope Packaged tuples and three Teams platforms. General fast feedback includes its original workspace compiler; General's full-qualification gate rejects Draft as merge qualification. CodeQL and Sentry native jobs retain their Draft skips. Existing pinned OpenCode native/local-model lanes remain permitted; Claude/Codex routes remain finite TEST peers, with real vendor execution prohibited.

Original 15-second Process readiness, its distinct reference bound, P08/controller budgets, Teams hydration deadline, P09, P11 and genuine-donor M16 requirements remain unchanged. Local tests and passive observations do not qualify GUI/native/platform outcomes. Preserve original fail-fast dependencies, complete raw evidence and physical cleanup requirements.

## Venue boundary

This is one ordinary same-repository Draft opening with `maintainer_can_modify=false`. Keep both refs fixed and preserve all earlier PRs/cohorts. No dispatch, rerun, cancellation, metadata update, Ready transition, merge or auto-merge is requested. Later external metadata-triggered runs must be recorded separately from the original opened cohort; they cannot replace failed platform results.

The separately published action R1 is retained at `docs/plans/provider-migration/frontend-parity-2026-11-12/evidence/coobservation-2026-11-15/read-boundaries-ci-r1-20261116.md` on the working branch; that documentation checkpoint is not this frozen CI head.
